name: Alice Waters
bio: American chef, author and food activist. She opened Chez Panisse in Berkeley in 1971 and built the menu on fresh, seasonal produce from named local farms. She also began the Edible Schoolyard project in a Berkeley school. She worked with a pottery on a dinnerware line for her restaurant.

milestones.event: Opened the Chez Panisse Café upstairs, with an à la carte menu.
Started the Chez Panisse Foundation and the Edible Schoolyard.
Worked with Heath Ceramics and Christina Kim on the Chez Panisse dinnerware collection.
